title: Adding doubles like 6 + 6

explain.say: Look at your 2 hands. Each hand has 5 fingers. 5 and 5 make 10. That is a double. On the board, 6 counters join 6 more. Double 6 is 12.
A double means adding a number to itself. Here 3 and 3 make 6. The 2 sets match. A ladybird with 3 spots on each wing has 6 spots. What is double 4?
Here is double 5. The top row has 5. The bottom row has 5. Together they make 10, and the frame is full. Both parts match, so doubles are easy to remember.
Double 6 is 12. The first frame fills up with 10. 2 more go in the next frame. An egg box with 6 on each side holds 12 eggs.
Now try near doubles. 6 plus 7 is double 6 and 1 more. Double 6 is 12, and 1 more is 13. What is 7 plus 8?

faq.a: A double is a number added to itself, like 4 plus 4 or 6 plus 6. Doubling means making twice as many.
Near doubles are sums of two numbers next to each other, like 6 plus 7. Use the double you know, 6 plus 6 is 12, then add 1 more to get 13.
asks: How do I add 6 and 7 fast?

faq.a: Yes. A double is two equal groups, so it always splits into pairs. Double any whole number and the answer is even.

faq.q: Is doubling the same as times 2?
faq.a: Yes. Double 6 is 6 plus 6, which is the same as 2 times 6. Both give 12.
asks: Is double the same as multiplying by 2?

facts: Doubling any whole number always gives an even number.

wrong.1: 88 writes 8 twice. Double 8 means adding 8 and 8.

quiz.say: Use near doubles. What is 7 plus 8?

wrong.1: 14 is double 7. Add 1 more for the 8.
wrong.2: 16 is double 8. 7 is 1 less than 8, so take 1 away.
